top_signals.title: Must Think Of Wealth Transfers Differently: Zentner
top_signals.summary: Ellen Zentner, chief economic strategist and global head of thematic and macro investing at Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss how wealth managers must adjust to people living longer. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: United States on track for record crude oil production in 2026
top_signals.summary: We forecast U.S. crude oil production will average 13.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 13.7 million b/d set in 2025, in our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
